name: Amaguro Kimiko
source:
A quiet and timid girl who attends ordinary department. Due to her dark personality and passive attitude, she doesn't have any friends. Therefore she admires and holds good will for Raimu who is the completely opposite of her.

[spoiler]She is actually a masochist and has a bad relationship with her step-father who is also the cause of her androphobia.[/spoiler]
